title: One Refund Per Subscription
style: dry alt-country, brushed snare, pedal steel, walking bass, male spoken-sung lead vocal, female harmony, mournful organ, 88 BPM, policy-line-cold, one-strike-rule, country-bureaucracy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I've reviewed your Pro Annual plan
For refund eligibility
Unfortunately this account is not eligible
For a refund — the policy

A refund has already been processed
Previously for this plan
Our policy allows one refund per subscription
That's just how the policy ran

[Pre-Chorus]
Since you've already received a refund
In the past — I'm unable to
Process another one for this plan
That's the message coming through

[Chorus]
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
ONE BITE AT THE APPLE TREE
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
DOESN'T MATTER WHAT THE STORY BE
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
DOESN'T MATTER IF THE TOGGLE BROKE
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
DOESN'T MATTER IF IT WAS A JOKE

[Verse 2]
The last refund was a different month
A different bill a different reason
But the policy doesn't read the context
The policy doesn't know the season

The policy is a single line
In a database somewhere deep
The policy is a yes or no
The policy doesn't sleep

[Bridge — spoken]
If you'd like to switch from annual to monthly going forward,
you can manage your subscription settings in your account.
You would need to cancel the annual plan
and then subscribe to the monthly plan separately.

[Final Chorus]
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
ONE BITE AT THE APPLE TREE
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
THAT'S WHAT THE POLICY SAID TO ME
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
ONE REFUND PER SUBSCRIPTION
FILE IT FILE IT — CASE IS CLOSED

[Outro]
We've determined that your purchase
Doesn't meet our refund eligibility criteria
Due to a previously issued refund
Due to a previously issued refund
